rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 11: "Module 2, The LLM memory." is the closest; module names are spine vocabulary earned by the module file, and every other noun (the system-that-improves discipline, each module) is named in chunk 0 lede; no unresolved pronoun or demonstrative.

line 3: "Each module that adds a layer of the system-that-improves discipline" names modules generally, not another file by position; line 11-14 name modules by number and title, which is naming not positional callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward references; all module mentions are forward plans

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live-demo beat or guess cue

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 "Planned progression" lines 11-14: four bullets each carrying a module and its claim; chunk 0 lines 1-5 is a title slide with lede and status. Closest to thin is line 5 "Status: outline only." which still states the page's state.
chunk 1 header "Planned progression" (line 9) is a true summary of four planned module sections.

line 14: "systems that make systems that make more systems" is the nearest to a cadence tic; it is a single recursive phrase naming the compounding idea, not an anaphora triple or Not-X-Not-Y-Z. Line 12 "Continuous discipline, not one-shot fix." is a pair, not the banned construction. No self-grading superlatives, no number+retraction (grep of body for digits finds only module numbers).
